reason: Feasibility is fine: the item only logs a line, needs no build, slot or rule change, and its facts check out. exp89p = exp85a + n2a is a single-lever difference. n2a is the distilled secondary (y3uanm v1 recipe, epoch 2 of exp71, sha 7029fe69; CONTEXT l.2467, 3286-3303). exp81 was never submitted, so probe 54 is the first n2a read on the leaderboard. The old swap record is negative (probes 7, 10 and 13 fell by 0.007 to 0.024; probes 15-17 were at or below 0.947). The VALUE claim is what fails. Pre-registering that a 0.959 display 'OVERTURNS fine-tuning does not pay' overclaims. (1) 0.959 against 0.958 is a one-step difference on 3-decimal displays of one public embryo (~29% of the test). The lab's own DIS rule (CONTEXT l.3940-3942) accepts that rounded displays carry up to ~0.001 of error per pair, and it requires dd >= 0.002 before it calls anything '+'. (2) The prior against it is specific and negative: the SEC n2a dummy-lab gave -0.0008..-0.0020 on 5/5 pairs, with FP +4..+6 on 6bba. The same bed got the sign right for probe 10 (CONTEXT l.4244-4248). One read one step up cannot overturn a verdict built on 10 of 10 refutations plus 0 of 5 swaps. It says nothing about the private embryos (71%), and Q3 already limits SEC to V_pub. (3) The two-way mapping leaves out cases the frozen P codes handle (R30-A1, l.4273-4278). An ERROR or late read is '?' and should mean no C11 verdict, not 'upheld'. A 0.958 read is BLIND by construction, which is a non-read, not a clean 6th null. It also ignores probe 52 exp89r (exp87a + n2a, still PENDING, read ~09-10Z), the second n2a read, which the curator note should include. (4) Writing 'OVERTURNED' next to the P code at the 08:40Z decision header risks the label leaking into the finals discussion, where SEC must stay V_pub-only. Realistic value to the competition: none (the deadline is today and there is no GPU or training time). As written it is a record that overclaims, not a neutral one.
fix: Keep it as a record-only line, reworded before the score. The P code alone decides morning and finals use (R30-A1, unchanged). C11 note at the exp89p read: P '+' (>= 0.959, COMPLETE by the 08:40Z header) -> 'C11: first positive LB read of a distilled fine-tune, UNPROVEN (1 public embryo, a 0.001 display step, lab prior negative; no private claim; Q3 unchanged)'. P '0' (0.958, BLIND) or '-' -> 'C11 UPHELD (6th null/negative secondary change)'. '?' (ERROR, late, not terminal) -> 'no C11 read'. Add the exp89r (probe 52) read against exp87a as a second n2a data point (Rr code), and only when both are '+' write 'distillation = post-deadline line'. Dense-label retrains stay refuted either way. Write the line in the post-decision CONTEXT entry, after the A-M1 submit or UNUSED decision (by 08:45Z), not at the decision header.
realistic_gain: 0.000 on public and private (record only; no build or slot). It may help calibrate post-deadline work; it must not move any finals choice.
